_doc: Unified mode (docs/operations/SCALING.md §4a): one database, a schema per corpus, one engine. Each entry names the schema its corpus lives in, the BM25 vocabulary Ravel wrote beside its bundle (mounted read-only at /bundles from BUNDLES_DIR), and the algorithms it is ranked by. `dsn_env` (default DATABASE_URL) names the variable holding the connection string, never the string: it carries a password. Separated mode is the same list with one dsn_env per database.
